title: PRD-17 synthetic risk input syntax

organizationRef.description: required; permitted commercial buyer context. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

scheduleBatchRef.description: required; approved stable equipment row IDs. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: EQUIPMENT_SCHEDULE_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

equipmentClassCode.description: required per row; carrier-mapped category <= 80. Sensitivity: internal. Error: EQUIPMENT_CLASS_UNMAPPED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

declaredValue.description: required per row; positive with valuation basis. Sensitivity: financial. Error: EQUIPMENT_VALUE_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

locationRef.description: required per row; authorized site reference. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: LOCATION_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

useCode.description: required per row; declared business use <= 60. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: USE_UNMAPPED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

maintenanceEvidenceRef.description: conditional; current service evidence. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
